why: A wire is redundant when union-find reports that its two ends are already in the same component. Each redundant wire can be moved to join two components, so with c components you need c - 1 moves, possible only when there are at least c - 1 redundant wires (equivalently, at least n - 1 wires).
hints: Which wires can you unplug without disconnecting anything that is currently connected?
Process wires with union-find: if find(a) == find(b) the wire is redundant; otherwise it merges two components and the component count drops by one.
If connections.length < n - 1 return -1; otherwise answer = components - 1. O((n + m) alpha(n)).
